met_analysis:
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over Sikkim & neighbourhood at 3.1 km above mean sea level.
A trough runs form northeast Bihar to Northwest Bay of Bengal across Jharkhand and Gangetic West Bengal at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
A trough runs form south Bihar to Vidarbha across east Madhya Pradesh at 5.8 km above mean sea level.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over Gulf of Mannar & adjoining south coastal Tamil Nadu at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
A trough runs from above cyclonic circulation over Gulf of Mannar & adjoining south coastal Tamil Nadu to east central Arabian Sea across north interior Tamil Nadu and north Kerala at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over South Interior Karnataka & adjoining north Kerala at 0.9 km above mean sea level has merged with the above trough.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Westcentral Arabian Sea between 3.1 & 7.6 km has become less marked.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over south Coastal Andhra Pradesh and neighbourhood extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level has become less marked.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over northeast Assam & neighbourhood extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level has become less marked.
The trough from north Bangladesh to Odisha across Gangetic West Bengal at 3.1 km above mean sea level has become less marked.
